title: Open Design Skill Manifest
description: JSON Schema for the `od:` front-matter block in SKILL.md files. Validates only the Open Design extension block; base fields (name, description, triggers) follow the Claude Code SKILL.md spec.

mode.description: Artifact type the skill produces. Falls back to keyword inference from description + body when absent. Source: normalizeMode() in apps/daemon/src/skills.ts

surface.description: Display surface for UI filter pills. Inferred from mode if absent. Source: normalizeSurface()

platform.description: Target device class. Inferred from description keywords (mobile/phone/ios/android) if absent; defaults to 'desktop' for prototype mode, null for non-prototype. Source: normalizePlatform()

scenario.description: Business-domain filter pill. Known vocabulary: general, engineering, product, design, marketing, sales, finance, hr, operations, support, legal, education, personal. Unknown values pass through verbatim. Inferred from description keywords if absent. Source: normalizeScenario()

category.description: Free-form category slug for UI filter pills. Lowercase alphanumeric + dashes, max 64 chars. Not part of system-prompt composition. Source: normalizeCategory()

type.description: Template variant classifier for mode: template skills (e.g. 'hyperframes'). Not formally typed in SkillInfo; consumed by frontend/pipeline code.

upstream.description: Source repository URL. Source: upstream field in SkillInfo

featured.description: Gallery priority. Lower numbers float to top; true maps to 1; absent/null means no priority (alphabetical order). Source: normalizeFeatured() — accepts numeric strings such as "1".

example_prompt.description: Explicit sample prompt for 'Use this prompt' fast-create. Falls back to description's first sentence (max 320 chars). Source: derivePrompt()

fidelity.description: Visual fidelity hint for prototype skills. Other values collapse to null (form default: high-fidelity). Source: normalizeFidelity()

speaker_notes.description: Metadata hint for deck skills. Interpreted via normalizeBoolHint() — accepts booleans and 'true'/'false'/'yes'/'no'/'1'/'0' strings.

animations.description: Metadata hint. Interpreted via normalizeBoolHint() — accepts booleans and 'true'/'false'/'yes'/'no'/'1'/'0' strings.

default_for.description: One or more scenario tags for which this skill is the default. Single string or array of strings. Source: normalizeDefaultFor()

inputs.description: Typed form fields the user fills before generation.

parameters.description: Live-tweakable sliders available during and after generation.

capabilities_required.description: Agent capabilities gating — e.g. 'surgical_edit', 'file_write'. Skill won't activate unless the selected agent supports every listed capability.

aggregates_examples.description: Internal flag set by the daemon when a skill ships derived example subdirectories. Not authorable — the daemon computes it from disk.

requires.description: Whether to inject the active DESIGN.md into the system prompt. Default: true. Source: designSystemRequired in SkillInfo

sections.description: Prune DESIGN.md to these named sections before injection. Short names (color, typography, layout, components) are accepted aliases. Source: design_system.sections in SKILL.md frontmatter

generates.description: This skill PRODUCES a DESIGN.md rather than consuming one. Source: design_system.generates

requires.description: Craft rule slugs to inject into the system prompt. Resolved to <projectRoot>/craft/<slug>.md. Missing slugs are silently skipped. Source: normalizeCraftRequires()

type.description: Preview renderer hint. Default: 'html' when absent. Source: previewType in SkillInfo

entry.description: Relative path to the primary preview file. Default: first match of the sniffed type in the artifact directory.

reload.description: How the preview refreshes on file change (e.g. 'debounce-100'). Optional.

required.description: Whether the field must be filled before generation

default.description: Default value. Type must match the field type.

min.description: Minimum value (integer fields) or minimum length (string fields)

max.description: Maximum value (integer fields) or maximum length (string fields)

type.description: Slider type — determines UI rendering and value semantics

policy.description: Critique Theater policy for this skill. 'required' forces panel on; 'opt-out' forces it off; 'opt-in' defers to rollout phase. Source: normalizeCritiquePolicy()
